title: Blockley Lancaster Memorial
memorial_details: Plaque to F/L D.F. Langham DFC, KIA 15 February 1944, at the village cemetery gates, Blockley, Gloucestershire.
narrative: Lancaster ND445 of 7 Squadron (Pathfinder Force), coded MG-D, departed Oakington at 1714 on 15 February 1944 for Berlin. The aircraft possibly came down at 5700m approximately 45km north of Berlin, intercepted by Oberleutnant Helmuth Schulte of Stab II/NJG5, his fourth claim, and crashed near Linde. All seven crew were killed. Flight Lieutenant D.F. Langham DFC, who held the Distinguished Flying Cross, has a memorial plaque at the village cemetery gates at Blockley in Gloucestershire.
cause_of_loss: Possibly shot down by night fighter — Oblt Helmuth Schulte (Stab II/NJG5), 4th claim
